description: This file defines the 'SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton' class, a PHP class responsible for rendering and managing action buttons (such as 'Add' or 'Create') in the subpanel top area of the SuiteCRM interface. It includes methods for generating forms, buttons, and handling subpanel relationship logic.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton
classes.description: A PHP class extending SugarWidget to generate subpanel top buttons, such as 'Add' buttons, with support for form generation, access control, and relationship handling in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes button properties based on parameters or array details, translating keys to labels via app_strings and translate().

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Generates a unique widget ID string, optionally appending a '_button' suffix.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Creates an HTML form or URL string for the button action, populating form fields based on defines and additional form fields; supports output as URL or HTML form.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the button, including access control checks, optionally as a non-button link or as a button with form submission.

methods.name: _create_json_encoded_popup_request
methods.description: Encodes popup request data into a JSON string.

methods.name: get_subpanel_relationship_name
methods.description: Determines and returns the relationship name associated with a subpanel, based on the subpanel definition.
